## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Ferney-Voltaire, France. It starts at Allée du Château.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Immerse yourself in Voltaire's spirit at Château de Voltaire à Ferney, home to the famed writer for 20 years. See some of his own work, plus sculptures and art collections. Get the history on this legendary man of many talents, and explore a chapel, an orangery, and beautiful gardens.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €9.85. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 44 ratings and 35 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
